query:
SELECT k.id AS "id!", k.user_id AS "user_id!: UserId",
                  u.name AS "user_name!", k.name AS "name!",
                  k.key_prefix AS "key_prefix!", k.created_at AS "created_at!",
                  k.last_used_at, k.expires_at, k.revoked_at
             FROM user_api_keys k
             JOIN users u ON u.id = k.user_id
            WHERE ($1 = 'all')
               OR ($1 = 'active' AND k.revoked_at IS NULL)
               OR ($1 = 'revoked' AND k.revoked_at IS NOT NULL)
            ORDER BY
              CASE WHEN $3 = 'desc' THEN
                CASE $2 WHEN 'used' THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM k.last_used_at)
                        WHEN 'expires' THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM k.expires_at)
                        ELSE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM k.created_at) END
              END DESC NULLS LAST,
              CASE WHEN $3 = 'asc' THEN
                CASE $2 WHEN 'used' THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM k.last_used_at)
                        WHEN 'expires' THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM k.expires_at)
                        ELSE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM k.created_at) END
              END ASC NULLS LAST,
              CASE WHEN $2 = 'name' AND $3 = 'desc' THEN k.name END DESC,
              CASE WHEN $2 = 'name' AND $3 = 'asc' THEN k.name END ASC,
              k.id
            LIMIT $4 OFFSET $5
